text: {"lessons":["I should judge holdings by risk and future prospects, not by the discomfort of realizing a loss or the satisfaction of locking in a gain.","Selling Stock E at a gain and later buying it back lower, or buying Stock A again at a higher price, does not make past price moves reliable guides to future returns.","Periods of sharp account fluctuations remind me to stay diversified, size positions deliberately, and trade only when my investment case changes—not simply because prices moved."]}
